text:
I fixed the width problem; it's a small change to `src/TaxWise.App/wwwroot/css/app.css` only. I haven't run the app to look at it yet, so please check it in a maximized window and a narrow one.

**Width fix:** All four pages already used the same frame: a content area on the left and the 360px source panel on the right. The difference was inside the content area:
- **Ask:** answers were capped at 760px wide. I removed the cap, so they now fill the content area. Your own question bubbles still stop at 70% width so the chat still reads like a chat.
- **Quizzes:** quiz content was also capped at 760px. I removed that cap too.
- **Explain my form and Calculator:** these two-column layouts already filled the full width, but in a narrow window they ran off the edge and scrolled sideways. The two columns now share the full width and drop into a single column when the window gets too narrow.

So in full screen, all four pages should now fill the whole area next to the source panel. The one exception is the short welcome message on Ask before you ask anything, which I left centered at 640px. Say if you want that full width too.

**Upload my form:** A background agent is building this on its own copy of the repo, so it won't conflict with the CSS edit above. It will:
- add an API endpoint that accepts a W-2 or 1098-T PDF, reads its text, and has Claude pull out the box values;
- turn on the "Upload mine" tab, which is currently disabled;
- add tests and update the docs;
- commit to a new branch, `upload-my-form`, without pushing.

It won't keep uploaded files, it will hide SSNs, and scanned PDFs with no readable text will get a clear error message. I'll tell you what it built when it finishes.

author: cnash03
text:
"Upload mine" now works on the Explain my form page, on a new branch `upload-my-form` (commit `898107a`). The project builds and all tests pass, but no real W-2 or 1098-T PDF has gone through it yet and nobody has used the page in the running app. The branch isn't pushed and there's no PR.

**How it works:**
- **Upload:** you pick a PDF (5 MB max) and the server reads its text. Claude pulls out only the box values. Those values are placed onto the existing sample W-2 or 1098-T, so clicking a box gives the same cited explanations as the samples. Where each box goes on your return still comes from the checked sample, never from Claude.
- **Privacy:** the file is processed in memory and never saved to disk. The SSN, EIN, names and addresses are never extracted. As a backup, anything that looks like an SSN is masked to `XXX-XX-1234`. Box values are never written to the logs.
- **Rejected uploads:** these get a plain message. That covers a scanned or photographed PDF with no readable text, a damaged or password-protected file, a form that isn't a W-2 or 1098-T, a tax year other than 2025, or no box values found.
- **Tests and docs:** new tests for the upload logic and the endpoint. The README and build plan no longer call this a stretch goal, and DECISIONS.md has a new entry (#17).

**Limits to know about:**
- **Fillable PDFs:** if the values exist only in form fields, they may come back with no boxes. The error tells the student to print the form to a new PDF first.
- **Boxes shown:** only the boxes on the sample form appear. Other W-2 boxes and other box 12 codes are left out.
- **App build on your Mac:** the app only compiles with `-p:ValidateXcodeVersion=false`. The installed .NET Mac SDK expects Xcode 27.1 and you have 27.2.

My width fix is still uncommitted on `main`. Both changes touch `app.css`, but in different sections, so merging them should be clean.

Next, I can merge the upload branch locally so you can try both changes in the running app with a real W-2. After that I can commit, push and open PRs.

author: cnash03
text:
I found and fixed the real cause of the width problem. The app has been rebuilt and is running on the latest code, with the API still up. I couldn't see it after the fix: TaxWise opened behind another window, so my screenshot caught your browser instead. I deleted that screenshot without using it.

**What was wrong:** the element the app loads into in `src/TaxWise.App/wwwroot/index.html` had a class meant only for the "Loading…" message. That class centers whatever is inside it. When the app loaded, it replaced the message but kept the class, so every page was centered and only as wide as its own content. Each page has different content, so each was a different width.

Before fixing it, I added temporary logging to measure this. The window and web view were the full 1964px, but the app's outer container was only 1389px. That confirmed the cause. I've since removed the logging.

**The fix:** the loading message now sits in its own inner element, so it and its class go away once the app loads. Every page then fills the window.

My earlier CSS fixes stay in, because they still help:
- no width caps on Ask answers or Quizzes
- the form pages drop to one column in a narrow window
- the header controls wrap instead of pushing the page wider

**Please check:** switch to the TaxWise window and click through Ask, Explain my form, Calculator and Quizzes in full screen. All four should now line up exactly, with the source panel at the right edge.

Everything is still uncommitted on `upload-my-form`: the file picker fix in `Entitlements.plist`, the CSS changes, and the `index.html` fix. Tell me if the widths look right and I'll commit them.
